reviews.review_description:
As far as how it plays at launch, actually it plays really good and its launched in a much better state then its competitors did at launch, however there are some issues, 

The tutorial was abit annoying to get through just based on controls and upon finishing it i immediately changed the turning of the table control to be "flipped" would of liked those settings options before even starting the tutorial but nonetheless still got through it, 

There is no rest or spider in the game, these are necessities in snooker so I've no idea why they are missing, probably because and this brings me onto the other huge issue, there is no table boundry ie you can phase through the table to line up your shots, that i find to be very annoying that something as basic as that at launch isn't there, it defeats the whole purpose of a snooker table because its no longer a big table, this is snooker after all, we cannot walk into the middle of the table irl we are not ghosts, put the rest & spider & extended rest into the game and patch in the table boundry, even as an option 

There seems to be a default power for your shots so that makes it quite difficult to judge power when you need it, the default power is too high, this needs to be either mostly or just all simulation ie the power you get is determined exactly by how you play the shot & your stroke, as is i also find the balls are abit too light, especially when smashing into them, they break up way too easily, the balls need to be heavier and as i said the power/stroke situation needs to be changed, 

Other the that, for this kinda table, the cushions are not playing as they should (with this particular type of table) thats more nitpicky but they are just abit too slick, and the pockets are abit too tight, they need to be loosened ever so slightly, its not a tournament table, those pockets are just abit too stubbon, they need to accept it when you power a ball in cz in snooker you will need to at times, but the pockets are not tuned for that right now and thats a problem, 

Those are my thoughts, but i really enjoyed it even as is and if the devs made the adjustments i left here and additions then this will be the best snooker game on Quest, for the £7 pre order im pleasantly surprised, its very good, but not perfect not yet anyway

Ok Opponents not that good. Does not acknowledge breaks made & does not end the frame when too far in front with just the black left or requiring multiple snookers. Sometimes cannot place hand on table or cushion which makes aiming v difficult Hopefully patches will address some of these issues.Agree that having a rest would make this more realistic as well as restricting low cue ball striking when close to another object ball or cushion

reviews.review_title: Great. I wanted snooker for ages.
reviews.review_description: MiRacle Pool is one of my favourite/most played games. I love the snooker mode in that, so I had to buy this. Can we get a 9ft table size, even if only for single player? I like to play with the aiming aid off against the AI, but full-size is difficult. 9FT would be a great middle ground between small and full-size. Also maybe an option for 6 or 10 reds, even if only in single player. Thanks

These Devs are so bad at listening to their customer's Miracle pool has been out for years and black hole pool even longer and still they refuse to fix the bugs in both games,  they released this game without pro controller support, madness, there are two other snooker vr games that are miles ahead in terms of physics and fun, don't waste your money on this unless there are some major patches, and if they do patch it and make it decent I'll be the first to change my review as I have for other games. Just updating my review slightly as I think I was a little hard, but I stand by what I said initially, the game has the basics but I'm afraid that's as good as it gets for now.

The balls are a little bit out of the correct scale by at least 2mm smaller, and two 2mm over a pack of 15 red balls adds up to a noticeably smaller pack.

Also I would like some basic stats, like highest break and current break. The baulk line and D is also very thick, I would either fade it out slightly or make much thinner. Also when in practice mode, I can't respot the colours properly because there are no spots. I would like the option to turn off the spot the projects out of the end of the cue onto the white ball, like in Miracle Pool too.

I'm enjoying the game so far as it is, it's very good, but I hope you will fix most of these things within the the next few weeks, because the game really needs these things to make it the best possible. And for me the main thing is the correct ball size

developer_response.body: Hi Atlas.VTO, Thanks for the review. Regarding to scale, all the dimensions are based on official specifications including the ball diameter. In VR, objects can appear smaller but to be physically accurate we need to use the specification numbers.

reviews.review_description: Basic and the rules seem to be accurate enough, yes adding the rest and not ghosting into the table would make the game more realistic. Female comentator on single player is abit annoying (keeps telling me to "go on then"). Overall not bad for the price and i'm sure a few updates are in the pipeline.

I've been waiting for a good Snooker game for ages, this is a great game! 
I would love to have the option to move the table in the direction of the left thumbstick as opposed to it moving as the way you would walk. 
But I love it! 
Nice one!
